Actuator.description: A physical actuator driving one or more joints (coupling factor per joint).

ActuatorDrive.description: Which of the profile's actuators (or `*` = all servo channels) a board drives.

mouth_hz.description: Mouth amplitude rate (plan §7b: one rate, here).

direction.description: `in` = client mic to runtime, `out` = runtime TTS to client.

current.description: The board's own draw plus what it powers directly (LEDs on it).

dims_mm.description: Length x width x height, mm.

firmware.description: Repo path of the firmware we flash, if we own it.

role.description: What it does in this droid, one line.

BoardMount.description: A board's place in the body: which bracket holds it and its pose (model kit frame, on `link`).

bracket.description: The frame bracket / printed part it is fastened to.

link.description: Rig link it rides on (`torso_middle`, `head_tilt`, ...; `torso_lower` = the base).

q.description: Orientation, unit quaternion `[x, y, z, w]`; board +Z = its component side.

t.description: Board centre, metres, model kit frame (see the module docs).

center_us.description: Pulse at which the joint sits at `center_value`.

mm_per_deg.description: Prismatic joints: mm of travel per servo degree.

range_deg.description: Servo travel over the full pulse range.

ClientInfo.description: An authenticated gateway client. `source` is stamped on everything it sends.

CommentaryStatus.description: Where the DJ's next transition line is.

oneOf.description: Claude is writing it.
Written; the speech cache is synthesising it.
Cached audio, ready to play.

ConversationEvent.description: Turn lifecycle. The turn id rides on the envelope's `conversation_id`.

oneOf.description: Streaming reply text (a delta).
The whole reply, show tags stripped.
First audible sample.
Mouth amplitude 0..1 at the profile's `audio.mouth_hz`, in step with playback.

Character timing of the line being spoken: ms from its first audible sample, which was
heard at `audio_t0` (bus `t_mono` seconds). One event per synthesis chunk.

Brain -> voice: queue this line on the one speech FIFO. `reply` = the turn's reply (the
envelope's `conversation_id` is the turn); plan lines carry their `clip_id` instead.
A tool the brain executed (router or Claude, per the envelope `source`) and its outcome.
Brain -> speech cache: synthesise `text` now and hold it under `key`.
Play a cached line; exactly one `CachedPlaybackEnded` with the same `playback_id` follows.

ptt_owner.description: Client id holding push-to-talk, if any.

transmission.description: Fraction of the light that gets through, 0..1 (opal 3 mm ~0.5, frosted ~0.8).

DiffuserKind.description:
What covers a window: an `opal` or `frosted` diffuser mixes the LEDs behind it into one
evenly lit colour; `none` shows them as separate pixels.

oneOf.description: Opal (milky) acrylic: the LEDs vanish into one flat colour.
Frosted / sanded clear: one colour, a little hot in the middle.
No cover: each LED is seen.

step.description: The running transition plan's step, e.g. `music_crossfade (5/7)`; none between them.

oneOf.description: Stub.
Stub.

Engagement.description: Today's STARTUP/IDLE/AMBIENT/INTERACTIVE; gates the STT socket, ducking, mouse trigger.

Frames.description:
50 Hz body snapshot for the sim, the virtual driver and logs (plan §3b, D6).
Hardware servo controllers receive goals at event time, not frames.

joints.description: Joint name -> value in the joint's unit (deg or mm).

lights.description: Light group name -> one colour per pixel.

pad.description: The operator's gamepad while one drives the puppeteer (the panel's controller overlay).

GazeSource.description: The look target the head attends to in Show.

oneOf.description: A panel's 3D camera (`perf.look` from the owning panel).
The largest detected face (r3x-vision); straight ahead when nobody is seen.
Sound-source direction. Not implemented yet.
Straight ahead; idle glances only.

Hello.description: `hello` body: who the gateway thinks you are, full retained state, the robot profile.

IntentCommand.description: Things you ask the character to do; the brain decides how.

oneOf.description: Inject a line as if spoken.
Push-to-talk; ownership lands in `state.conversation.ptt_owner`.

A line for the runtime's command console (`help`, `status`, `eye pattern ...`): the
panel's command line and `r3x-cli` both send raw lines; the reply is `ops.console`.

Joint.description: A joint. Ranges nest: `hard ⊇ soft ⊇ animation` (motion-control.md §3).

extended.description: Only present on the extended build.

v_max.description: Per-second limits in the joint's unit.

LedEmulator.description: Which LED board emulator the performer runs for this package's lights.

oneOf.description: `rex_face_v3_clean` + `rex_chest_v1` (eyes 14, mouth 8, chest 33).
`firmware/grnwave_nano`: 3 body boards (96) + eyes (2) + mouth (8).
No LED board we drive: the performer keeps the native emulators for the preview.
Existing firmware named commands (`SI SE ...`, `Mnnn`, `Bnnn`, `Xn`, `Hxxx`).

board.description: Which board (`face`, `chest`); the identity check expects it.

port_hint.description: Env var or path hint for the serial port.

channels.description: Named channels (stage fixtures). Length must equal `pixels` when present.

layout.description: Per-pixel placement, when known. Length must equal `pixels`.

LightWindow.description:
A window of a panel: an opening that one or more of the group's LEDs light from behind,
under a [`Diffuser`]. With a mixing diffuser the window is one colour, so the firmware
and the performer author it as a unit; pixels not in any window are individual points.

centre.description: Centre of the diffuser face, metres, model kit frame (like [`LightPixel::pos`]).

id.description: Unique in the package (`p1_w0` = panel 1, its window 0 in firmware order).

leds.description: Indices into this light group's pixels (not the chain), in chain order.

panel.description: The panel it is cut in (`logic_panel_1`).

size_m.description: Width (along `u`) x height of the opening, metres.

u.description: The face's width direction (kit frame, unit, perpendicular to `normal`).

MessageClass.description: Message class; the gateway maps each authenticated client to an allowed set.

oneOf.description: Jump in the current track: to `seconds`, or `seconds` before the end with `from_end`.
Play `query` (a title, words of one, or `@semantic ...`); none = engine's choice.
Music owns `next` (plan 7b); DJ mode layers its own transition on top.
Jump in the current track (see [`MusicCommand::Seek`]).
Crossfade to `track` (library title) over `duration_s`; `CrossfadeComplete{id}` follows.
Duck to `level` (0..1) over `fade_ms`.

ending_at_s.description:
Position (s) in `track` where `music.track_ending_soon` fires (the DJ's transition
point); none for a track shorter than the threshold.

library.description: Track titles in the local library, sorted.

position_s.description:
Position (s) in `track` at bus time `position_t` (`t_mono`); extrapolate while
`playing`. With `track.bpm`/`first_beat_s` this is the performer's beat clock anchor.

oneOf.description: One measured latency leg of a turn.
Reply to an `intent.console` line.
Brain plan executor: a plan started on `layer` (ambient / foreground / show / override).
`status`: completed | failed | cancelled | paused.
Servo controller telemetry (rate-limited by the driver).

channels.description: Joint -> commanded pulse (µs, 0 = off) and follower position (joint units).

PackageLight.description: One light group of the package: becomes a profile [`LightGroup`].

board.description: The board the LEDs are on.

data_line.description: The data line that feeds it (`nano.D4`) and this group's first index on that line.

layout.description: Per pixel, in chain order. Length = `pixels`.

link.description: Rig link the group rides on (positions are given at the zero pose).

ma_per_led.description: One LED at full white (all three channels at 255), mA.

windows.description: Panel windows over some of these LEDs (the rest are individual points).

PadControls.description: What the operator layer is doing, for the overlay.

last.description: The last thing a button did, for a moment ("Nod", "DJ mode on", "refused: ...").

latched.description: Modifiers latched by a double tap (`l1`, `r1`, `r2`); a single tap unlatches.

layer.description:
The active layer's key in `pad.json` (`base`, `l1`, `r1`, `l1r1`, `r2`, `r2l1`, `r2r1`,
`r2l1r1`): the held and latched modifiers, settled for a moment.

pickup.description:
The left stick just changed hands and waits to be brought back to where its new target
is before it moves it (no jump).

pinned.description: Arms left where they are (L3 in an arm layer) instead of easing home.

stick.description: What the left stick drives right now.

PadFrame.description: A gamepad as the puppeteer read it this frame, and what it made of it.

axes.description: Standard gamepad layout: left x, left y, right x, right y in [-1, 1], down = +.

buttons.description:
Standard layout, one per button: 0 = up, else how far in (pressure where the pad
measures it, else 1).

controls.description: The runtime's operator layer (`r3x-pad` controls): absent from the sim's own pad.

intents.description:
The puppeteer's smoothed intents in [-1, 1] (gaze_yaw, gaze_pitch, lift, body_yaw,
lean, visor, arm_raise, energy).

path.description: Titles from the root to the open level.

PerfCommand.description: Direct body control. Goes to the performer.

oneOf.description: Play a clip, cue or sequence by id.

layer.description: Defaults to the item's own layer.

oneOf.description: Per-channel override: channel (joint or intent) -> value.
Release puppeted channels (empty = all); they ease back.
Fire an emote slot from the profile's `emotes`.

Bench calibration wizard: a raw pulse (us) to one servo actuator. Bench mode, `ui`/`cli`
only; the controller still moves it through its follower, inside the soft limits.

Bench calibration wizard: write what was measured into the robot profile
(`calibrated: measured`). `limits_us`: the pulses at the two soft-limit ends.

Bench/Studio reset. No `joints`: stop every run, release the puppet, turn autonomy and
the alive layers off, and hold every joint at the profile's home pose (reached through
the followers, inside each joint's v/a/j limits); the hold ends when something moves the
body again. With `joints`: hold just those at home. `ui`/`cli` only.

The viewport gaze target: (pan, tilt) degrees in the head_pan parent frame, from the panel
that owns `state.stage.gaze_owner`. Send ~15 Hz while it moves; a target older than 1 s
lapses to straight ahead.

Stop every run, refuse new ones; `on: false` releases. Same switch as
`StageCommand::Freeze` (`state.stage.frozen`); kept here for the puppeteer.

Show a named face pattern (`happy`, `thinking`, ...) through the face board, for
`duration` s; none = until the interaction state next changes (EYE_COMMAND).

Studio: play an unsaved clip document (SPEC clip JSON) from clip time `at`; `hold`
pins it there (scrubbing). The runtime takes it only from `ui`/`cli`, in Studio or
Bench, and only when the clip lints clean against the profile (Bench-safe limits).
Studio: blend the preview out.

Studio: write a clip or cue into the show folder as `<kind>s/<id>.json`. The runtime
validates and lints it first (it may add no new lint error); the folder reload
picks it up. `overwrite` is needed to replace an existing file.
A show's spoken line, for the voice to say (never from a Claude-sourced run).
A show ducks (`on`) or restores the music.
A show's stage-light action (the venue desk; frames carry the resulting output).
A show's face pattern (the performer renders it; mirrored to a board it does not own).
A show's chest override word, held for `hold` s (0 = until the status changes).
Authored loops under the activity (idle/DJ bop); lowest.

at_home.description: Every joint is within [`HOME_TOLERANCE`] of its home value.

homing.description: A whole-body Home is holding the home pose.

puppet.description: Puppeted channels and their current values.

max_ma.description: Everything on the rail at once at its worst (LEDs full white, servos stalled), mA.

psu.description: The supply this package calls for.

typical_ma.description: A show at the firmware's brightness, mA.

RetainedState.description: All retained state; the gateway `hello` body.

Rig.description:
The rig animation runs on: the robot profile the performer, Studio lint and the limits use.
Switching stops every run, homes, then reloads the performer with that profile.

oneOf.description: `robot.json` (or `R3X_PROFILE`): the limits and kinematics the show was authored on.
`robot.generated.json` next to it: generated from the mech model (`mech/rigsync`).

alive.description: Procedural alive layer -> enabled by default.

electronics.description:
The selected electronics package (`profiles/electronics/<id>.json`). Its light groups
become this profile's (`resolve_electronics`). `R3X_ELECTRONICS` overrides it at load.

home.description:
The home (park) pose Bench's Home eases to: joint -> value in its unit. A joint not
listed homes to 0 (its centre).

package.description: The resolved package (filled by `load`/`from_json`; the gateway's hello carries it).

Source.description: Who originated a message. Stamped by the bus/gateway, never self-declared by a client.

oneOf.description: Jev fast intent router.
Plan/timeline executor.
Authenticated control panel / Studio.
Idle policy.
Anonymous public-site visitor.
The runtime itself (stage manager, drivers, health).
CantinaOS bridge (Phase 1-6 strangler).

StageCommand.description: Stage manager: operating mode, output and layer switches.

oneOf.description: Choose the rig (`state.stage.rig`). Refused in Show while a show-layer run is playing.
Gate a driver output (profile actuator or light group name).
Toggle a procedural alive layer (e.g. `breathing`).
Autonomy and every alive layer off, in one change (Bench/Studio Home).
Choose the gaze target. `owner`: the panel claiming the viewport target.

A panel takes the gamepad from the runtime (`Some`, e.g. while it is in Build) or hands
it back (`None`). The last claim wins.

frozen.description: Every run stopped, new ones refused; the chest holds its state.

gaze.description: Where the head looks in Show (Bench and Studio ignore it).

gaze_owner.description:
With `gaze: viewport`: the panel whose 3D camera is the target (the last to select it);
none = whichever panel sends one.

outputs.description: Output name -> enabled. Enables gate drivers, not layers.

pad_owner.description:
The panel holding the gamepad (Build mode jogs the workbench with it); while set, the
runtime's pad operator layer stands down. None = the runtime drives with it.

rig.description: Which robot profile the performer, lint and limits use (the rig animation runs on).

StateUpdate.description: A whole-domain replacement; the gateway `state` body.

StickTarget.description: What a layer's left stick drives.

oneOf.description: Turn (x) and lean (y).
The hero arm: x spins the top ring to aim it, y raises it.
The poker arm: x spins the lower ring to aim it, y moves the claw tip up/down (IK).
Both arms together: x aims, y raises.

Support.description: How far our runtime drives something.

oneOf.description: A driver and firmware exist in this repo.
Some of it is driven (a package whose boards are a mix).
Described (dimensions, wiring, BOM) but nothing here talks to it.
Subscribe this client to 50 Hz `frames`.

VisionEvent.description: `r3x-vision` (Phase 6): presence transitions and scene descriptions, never per frame.

oneOf.description: An enrolled person appeared (edge, not per frame). `confidence` is cosine similarity.
They were absent for the exit hysteresis (10 frames at 5 fps).

Where the largest face is, as a gaze target: (pan, tilt) degrees from the camera's
field of view (published when it moves by more than a degree).
No face in view any more.
A Claude description of the current frame; `reason` is why it was taken.

description:
One message on the bus or the wire.

`t_mono` is seconds since the runtime's monotonic epoch; `t_wall` is Unix seconds.

oneOf.description: First message on connect.
Metadata for a following binary audio frame.

conversation_id.description: Turn id minted at capture and adopted downstream.

id.description: Client-chosen id on a command; echoed as `re` on its ack/result.
